title: A federal judge denies OpenAI's bid to see SpaceXAI's confidential settlement with Apple in an antitrust case, finding the materials irrelevant after a review (Hassan Ali Kanu/Politico)
summary: Hassan Ali Kanu / Politico: A federal judge denies OpenAI's bid to see SpaceXAI's confidential settlement with Apple in an antitrust case, finding the materials irrelevant after a review — A federal judge has denied OpenAI's request to force the disclosure of a settlement agreement between Apple and SpaceXAI …
